Missing-data rule strict: no skipping, no zero fill; unavailable with the reason; no inclusion parameter.
regular_open operand is the open of the regular-session daily bar of the exact session; end leg the same-session close; sources lacking an exact-session daily open make the leg unavailable.

Window extremes: period includes the current session, extreme_basis (intraday|close) explicit, no default, offset 0 = target, the latest session wins ties; 253 vs 252 is the design owner's single number, carried by the closeout binding table; the contract holds no second default.

Population standard deviation (divisor K) over the declared funds; withheld if any fund is missing.

Two operands, never swapped: session.price.range_over_open (P15, intraday-capable) divides by session.bar.open = operand label first_eligible_regular_trade (first eligible regular-session trade price); core regular_open (M10/M11, end of day) uses operand label daily_bar_open (official daily-bar open of the exact session). They can differ (first trade 100.00, official open 100.20); P15 and M11 figures are never compared or substituted.

Unit `sessions` (int64): a non-negative integer count of sessions before the target (0 = the target); not scaled, never a float, never negative; an offset output is unavailable whenever its extreme value is; INVALID_UNIT covers `sessions` offered where a price unit is required and a price unit offered where `sessions` is required. Additive vocabulary in the DV1 contract only; the E9 slash-style units and the EF5 contract are not edited.
Numeric near-tie rule and 'value within 1e-100 of zero published as computed' written in numeric_policy.

fixture_notation: compact, NOT canonical wire. K = 100, default known_at 50.
